messages:
Ava: Heads up team: rolling out a change to canary windows next week + a short soft-freeze. Please skim and flag blockers.
Ava: Summary: (1) Canary windows will be staggered by priority lane to reduce simultaneous cache warmups; (2) Soft freeze window: Tue 09:00 UTC -> Wed 09:00 UTC (minimal exceptions); (3) Emergency hotpatch path documented below.
Ava: Staggered windows (applies to US/EU regions):
````
Priority-1 (high): 01:30-03:30 UTC
Priority-2 (medium): 04:00-06:00 UTC
Priority-3 (low): 07:00-09:00 UTC
````
Liam: Quick context: last week we had 3 overlapping canaries that caused KV cache churn and a 12% p95 latency bump for serving-eu. Staggering should smooth the warmup curve.
Priya: Question: will this affect pre-scheduled batch rollouts (our weekly model refreshes)?
Ava: Priya: batch rollouts can proceed but please schedule your canary stage in your lane window. If you need to move lanes, file a release board request.
ops-bot: NOTE: Calendar updated for next 4 weeks. Canary reservations created: 12.
Nikhil: Emergency hotpatch flow (short): 1) post incident in #eng-oncall, 2) get oncall + release lead approval, 3) mark deploy metadata `emergency=true` and set `skip_canary=false` (we still run reduced canary), 4) notify Ops in deploy notes. I'll post the template in the doc.
Ava: Please add `kv-impact` label to PRs that touch kv/cache logic or quantization that affects serving warmup. Ops will pre-wire a warmup job when label present.
deploy-bot: BUILD: canary-priority1-4201239876 started (job id: cj-9042). Status: running.
Liam: Action items: release leads confirm lane by EOD Mon; infra: ensure autoscale thresholds for KV eviction metric are active; dev teams: add `kv-impact` label where applicable and schedule warmup run.
Priya: We'll update our release checklist to include `kv-impact` check and the emergency hotpatch template.
Ava: Linking doc w/ checklist and approval flow: https://redwood.internal/release/staggered-canary-2026. Please react :eyes: when read.
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Minor KV eviction spike detected 2026-04-02 02:42 UTC in serving-us. Autoscale mitigated. Filed INC-2026-0402-07.
Liam: Thanks. We should run one coordinated dry-run canary under the new schedule before the freeze to validate the process. Who can own?
Priya: We can own the dry-run for models team. Will schedule on Mon 05:00 UTC (medium lane) and invite SRE.
Ava: Perfect. I'll close with a reminder: soft freeze is to limit user-visible regressions during warmup spikes. Exceptions are rare; follow the emergency path. :sparkles:
